title: cli-default-tools-empty
request: hey, the CLI currently defaults to having the web_search tool even when I don't pass any --tools flag. can we change the default to an empty list so no tools are enabled unless explicitly requested?
reference_diff:
--- a/src/smolagents/cli.py
+++ b/src/smolagents/cli.py
@@ -78,7 +78,7 @@
     parser.add_argument(
         "--tools",
         nargs="*",
-        default=["web_search"],
+        default=[],
         help="Space-separated list of tools that the agent can use (e.g., 'tool1 tool2 tool3')",
     )
     parser.add_argument(
test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_cli_tools_default.py
@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+
+from smolagents.cli import parse_arguments
+
+
+def test_default_tools_is_empty(monkeypatch):
+    # Simulate running the CLI with no arguments
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["prog"])
+    args = parse_arguments()
+    assert args.tools == []
+
+
+def test_specified_tools_are_parsed(monkeypatch):
+    # Simulate running the CLI with explicit tools
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["prog", "--tools", "web_search", "python_interpreter"])
+    args = parse_arguments()
+    assert args.tools == ["web_search", "python_interpreter"]
